opening.argument: The segment is a Thanksgiving cooking Q&A, not an offer or transaction. Its WIRED Tech Support title identifies the format, and the presenters answer practical questions about dry-brining turkey, preparing Brussels sprouts with olive oil and salt, and thickening gravy with a roux. The kitchen setting and food demonstrations fit those questions. The closing request for more questions and comments is ordinary audience engagement, not a condition for receiving money, goods, account access, or investment returns. Nothing in the cited material establishes a promised payout or a required exchange; the observable content remains cooking advice and entertainment.
